arxiv-2101-02400.title: Regression-based causal inference with factorial experiments: estimands, model specifications, and design-based properties
arxiv-2101-02400.creator: Anqi Zhao, Peng Ding
arxiv-2101-02400.description: Abstract Factorial designs are widely used due to their ability to accommodate multiple factors simultaneously. Factor-based regression with main effects and some interactions is the dominant strategy for downstream analysis, delivering point estimators and standard errors simultaneously via one least-squares fit.

arxiv-2108-01079.title: Understanding Gamma-ray Burst Jet Structures from Afterglow Light Curves Journal: RNAAS
arxiv-2108-01079.creator: Celia R. Tandon, Nicole M. Lloyd-Ronning
arxiv-2108-01079.description: Abstract Gamma-ray bursts (GRBs), associated with the collapse of massive stars or the collisions of compact objects, are the most luminous events in our universe. However, there is still much to learn about the nature of the relativistic jets launched from the central engines of these objects.

arxiv-2110-12304.title: A Study of Acoustic Features in Arabic Speaker Identification under Noisy Environmental Conditions
arxiv-2110-12304.creator: Zhor Benhafid, Kawthar Yasmine Zergat, Abderrahmane Amrouche
arxiv-2110-12304.description: Abstract One of the major parts of the voice recognition field is the choice of acoustic features which have to be robust against the variability of the speech signal, mismatched conditions, and noisy environments. Thus, different speech feature extraction techniques have been developed. In this paper, we investigate the robustness of several front-end techniques in Arabic speaker identification.

arxiv-2204-02671.title: Behavioral uncertainty quantification for data-driven control
arxiv-2204-02671.creator: Alberto Padoan, Jeremy Coulson, Henk J. van Waarde, John Lygeros, Florian Dörfler
arxiv-2204-02671.description: Abstract This paper explores the problem of uncertainty quantification in the behavioral setting for data-driven control. Building on classical ideas from robust control, the problem is regarded as that of selecting a metric which is best suited to a data-based description of uncertainties.

arxiv-2211-13204.title: Totally Symmetric Quasigroups of Order 16
arxiv-2211-13204.creator: Hy Ginsberg
arxiv-2211-13204.description: Abstract We present the number of totally symmetric quasigroups (equivalently, totally symmetric Latin squares) of order 16, as well as the number of isomorphism classes of such objects. Totally symmetric quasigroups of orders up to and including 16 that are (respectively) medial, idempotent, and unipotent are also enumerated. Keywords: Quasigroups, Latin squares, totally symmetric, medial.

arxiv-2304-03219.title: Modification of Lie’s transform perturbation theory for charged particle motion in a magnetic field
arxiv-2304-03219.creator: Linjin Zheng
arxiv-2304-03219.description: Abstract It is pointed out that the conventional Lie transform perturbation theory for the guiding center motion of charged particles in a magnetic field needs to be modified for ordering inconsistency. There are two reasons. First, the ordering difference between the temporal variation of gyrophase and that of the other phase space coordinates needs to be taken into account.

arxiv-2310-07601.title: Modular transform of free fermion generalised Gibbs ensembles and generalised power partitions
arxiv-2310-07601.creator: Max Downing
arxiv-2310-07601.description: Abstract In Downing:2021mfw a conjecture for the modular transformation of the free fermion generalised Gibbs ensemble (GGE) was given where only the KdV charge associated to the weight four quasi primary field was inserted. In this paper we first generalise this conjecture to the case with an arbitrary, finite collection of KdV charges in the GGE.

arxiv-2403-05059.title: Bug Priority Change: An Empirical Study on Apache Projects
arxiv-2403-05059.creator: Zengyang Li, Guangzong Cai, Qinyi Yu, Peng Liang, Ran Mo, Hui Liu
arxiv-2403-05059.description: Abstract In issue tracking systems, each bug is assigned a priority level (e.g., Blocker, Critical, Major, Minor, or Trivial in JIRA from highest to lowest), which indicates the urgency level of the bug. In this sense, understanding bug priority changes helps to arrange the work schedule of participants reasonably, and facilitates a better analysis and resolution of bugs.

arxiv-2407-07664.title: A Coding-Theoretic Analysis of Hyperspherical Prototypical Learning Geometry
arxiv-2407-07664.creator: Martin Lindström, Borja Rodríguez-Gálvez, Ragnar Thobaben, Mikael Skoglund
arxiv-2407-07664.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Martin Lindström, Borja Rodríguez-Gálvez, Ragnar Thobaben, Mikael Skoglund. Hyperspherical Prototypical Learning (HPL) is a supervised approach to representation learning that designs class prototypes on the unit hypersphere. The prototypes bias the representations to class separation in a scale invariant and known geometry. Previous approaches to HPL have either of the following shortcomings: (i) they follow an unprincipled optimisation procedure; or (ii) they are theoretically sound, but are constrained to only one possible latent dimension. In this paper, we address both shortcomings.

arxiv-2407-09932.title: Quantum Clock Synchronization Network with Silicon-chip Dual-Pumped Entangled Photon Source
arxiv-2407-09932.creator: Jiaao Li, Hui Han, Xiaopeng Huang, Bangying Tang, Kai Guo, Jinquan Huang, Siyu Xiong, Wanrong Yu, Zhaojian Zhang, Junbo Yang, Bo Liu, Huan Chen, Zhenkun Lu
arxiv-2407-09932.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a quantum clock synchronization (QCS) network scheme with silicon-chip dual-pumped entangled photon source. This scheme couples two pump beams into the silicon-based waveguide, where degenerate and non-degenerate spontaneous four-wave mixing (SFWM) occurs, generating entanglement between one signal channel and three idler channels.

arxiv-2410-00038.title: A Novel Spinor-Based Embedding Model for Transformers
arxiv-2410-00038.creator: Rick White
arxiv-2410-00038.description: Abstract This paper proposes a novel approach to word embeddings in Transformer models by utilizing spinors from geometric algebra. Spinors offer a rich mathematical framework capable of capturing complex relationships and transformations in high-dimensional spaces. By encoding words as spinors, we aim to enhance the expressiveness and robustness of language representations.

arxiv-2412-14745.title: Union-Free Generic Depth for Non-Standard Data
arxiv-2412-14745.creator: Hannah Blocher, Department of Statistics, Ludwig-Maximilians-University Munich
arxiv-2412-14745.description: Abstract Non-standard data, which fall outside classical statistical data formats, challenge state-of-the-art analysis. Examples of non-standard data include partial orders and mixed categorical-numeric-spatial data. Most statistical methods required to represent them by classical statistical spaces. However, this representation can distort their inherent structure and thus the results and interpretation.

arxiv-2509-18146.title: Global Bifurcations and Pattern Formation in Target–Offender–Guardian Crime Models
arxiv-2509-18146.creator: Madi Yerlanov, Qi Wang, Nancy Rodríguez
arxiv-2509-18146.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Madi Yerlanov, Qi Wang, Nancy Rodríguez. We study a reaction–advection–diffusion model of a target–offender–guardian system designed to capture interactions between urban crime and policing. Using Crandall–Rabinowitz bifurcation theory and spectral analysis, we establish rigorous conditions for both steady-state and Hopf bifurcations. These results identify critical thresholds of policing intensity at which spatially uniform equilibria lose stability, leading either to persistent heterogeneous hotspots or oscillatory crime–policing cycles.

arxiv-2512-12777.title: State over Tokens: Characterizing the Role of Reasoning Tokens
arxiv-2512-12777.creator: Mosh Levy, Zohar Elyoseph, Shauli Ravfogel, Yoav Goldberg
arxiv-2512-12777.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate reasoning tokens before their final answer to boost performance on complex tasks. While these sequences seem like human thought processes, empirical evidence reveals that they are not a faithful explanation of the model’s actual reasoning process. To address this gap between appearance and function, we introduce the State over Tokens (SoT) conceptual framework.

arxiv-2601-18916.title: Reconsidering the consistent use of precessing, higher order multipole models for gravitational wave analyses 2025 Affiliation: Institute of Cosmology and Gravitation, University of Portsmouth, Portsmouth, PO1 3FX, UK Reconsidering the consistent use of precessing, higher order multipole models for
arxiv-2601-18916.creator: C. Hoy
arxiv-2601-18916.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by C. Hoy. The growing number of gravitational-wave (GW) observations allows for constraints to be placed on the underlying population of black holes; current estimates show that black hole spins are small, with binaries more likely to have comparable component masses. Since general relativistic effects, such as spin-induced orbital precession and higher order multipole moments, are more likely to be observed for asymmetric binary systems, a direct measurement remains unlikely.

arxiv-2602-12746.title: Lamer-SSL: Layer-aware mixture of LoRA experts for continual multilingual expansion of self-supervised models without forgetting
arxiv-2602-12746.creator: Jing Xu, Minglin Wu, Xueyuan Chen, Xixin Wu, Helen Meng
arxiv-2602-12746.description: Abstract Despite their impressive performance, self-supervised speech models often struggle to generalize to new languages and tend to forget previously acquired knowledge during continual training. To address this, we propose Lamer-SSL, a parameter-efficient framework that integrates a L ayer- A ware M ixtur E of Lo R A Experts (Lamer) module with a replay strategy.

arxiv-2602-18252.title: On the Adversarial Robustness of Discrete Image Tokenizers
arxiv-2602-18252.creator: Rishika Bhagwatkar, Irina Rish, Nicolas Flammarion, Francesco Croce
arxiv-2602-18252.description: Abstract Discrete image tokenizers encode visual inputs as sequences of tokens from a finite vocabulary and are gaining popularity in multimodal systems, including encoder-only, encoder-decoder, and decoder-only models. However, unlike CLIP encoders, their vulnerability to adversarial attacks has not been explored.

arxiv-2605-14822.title: Nonlinear Hamiltonians and Boolean satisfiability
arxiv-2605-14822.creator: Michael R. Geller, Victoria S. Ordonez, Yohannes Abate

europmc-pmc3406960.title: TGFβ signaling plays a critical role in promoting alternative macrophage activation.
europmc-pmc3406960.creator: Gong D, Shi W, Yi SJ, Chen H, Groffen J, Heisterkamp N.
europmc-pmc3406960.description: Background Upon stimulation with different cytokines, macrophages can undergo classical or alternative activation to become M1 or M2 macrophages. Alternatively activated (or M2) macrophages are defined by their expression of specific gene products and play an important role in c

pmc-11333479.title: Association between systemic immune-inflammation index and cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome
pmc-11333479.creator: Chenxuan Gao, Shizhen Gao, Renpei Zhao, Peimin Shen, Xiaorui Zhu, Yane Yang, Conghao Duan, Yansi Wang, Huan Ni, Lanping Zhou, Yunfang Xiang, MeiJu Li, Zhao Xu, Yibing Wang, Haijie Yang, Chuanwei Zhao
pmc-11333479.description: This study aims to explore the relationship between the Systemic Immune-Inflammation Index (SII) and Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic (CKM) Syndrome and its components. Data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) from 2001 to 2018 were analyzed. CKM Syndrome is defined as the coexistence of Cardiometabolic Syndrome (CMS) and Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD).

pmc-11518311.title: The association between electronic media use and quality of life (QoL) in Norwegian adolescents
pmc-11518311.creator: A L Kleppang, T H Stea, T Bonsaksen, M Leonhardt, L Lien, A M Steigen
pmc-11518311.description: BackgroundThe use of screens, especially mobile devices like tablets and smartphones have increased over the last years and have become an integrated part of modern life. Adolescents today spend a lot of their time using screens both at school and outside school.

pmc-11532351.title: Korean nurses’ knowledge, opinions and current practice of trauma-informed pediatric nursing care in South Korea: a descriptive study
pmc-11532351.creator: Kyung-Sook Bang, Sun Woo Hong, Hwal Lan Bang, Ji-Hye Choe, Sinyoung Choi
pmc-11532351.description: PurposeThis study aimed to investigate the knowledge, opinions, competence, and barriers of nurses providing trauma-informed care (TIC) to children in hospitals.MethodsData were collected from 198 nurses nationwide using the TIC Provider Survey developed by the Center for Pediatric Traumatic Stress in July, 2024. Descriptive statistics, t tests, and one-way ANOVA were conducted using the IBM SPSS Statistics software (ver. 23.

pmc-11679096.title: Cross-Field Road Markings Detection Based on Inverse Perspective Mapping
pmc-11679096.creator: Eric Hsueh-Chan Lu, Yi-Chun Hsieh, Tomás Mateo Sanguino
pmc-11679096.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). With the rapid development of the autonomous vehicles industry, there has been a dramatic proliferation of research concerned with related works, where road markings detection is an important issue. When there is no public open data in a field, we must collect road markings data and label them by ourselves manually, which is huge labor work and takes lots of time. Moreover, object detection often encounters the problem of small object detection. The detection accuracy often decreases when the detection distance increases.

pmc-12507110.title: Optimizing α-galactosidase A enzyme cutoff for Fabry disease screening in chronic kidney disease patients: a single-center reassessment of diagnostic yield and cost-effectiveness
pmc-12507110.creator: Shang-Feng Tsai, Ming-Ju Wu, Hsien-Hsu Hsieh, Cheng-Hsu Chen
pmc-12507110.description: Fabry disease has been increasingly recognized in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD). While dried blood spot (DBS) testing for α-galactosidase A (α-Gal A) activity is a common screening method, the optimal cutoff value for enzyme activity in this population remains uncertain.

pmc-12664123.title: Exploring Nirmatrelvir Derivatives Through P2 Substituent Modifications and Warhead Innovations Targeting the Main Protease of SARS‐CoV‐2
pmc-12664123.creator: Felipe Cardoso Prado Martins, Johannes Lang, Fernanda dos Reis Rocho, Xianxian Wang, Vinícius Bonatto, Jerônimo Lameira, Christian Klein, Carlos Alberto Montanari
pmc-12664123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The COVID‐19 pandemic underscored the urgent need for effective antiviral agents, particularly against coronaviruses, which pose a continuing threat of future outbreaks. Targeting the main protease (Mpro), a key enzyme in viral replication, represents a promising therapeutic strategy. This study investigates structural modifications to known Mpro inhibitors, focusing on substitutions at the P2 position to explore alterations in both inhibitory potency and metabolic stability.

pmc-12904483.title: Decoding myoepithelioma: Highlighting diagnostic dilemmas through a series of rare cases
pmc-12904483.creator: Mangesh Londhe, Neil Abhay Shah, Sushama Gurwale, Charusheela Gore
pmc-12904483.description: Myoepitheliomas are exceedingly rare neoplasms of the salivary glands. Minor salivary gland neoplasms most frequently occur in the palate (hard palate), followed by the lips, oral mucosa, and tongue/floor of the mouth. Additionally, less prevalent locations encompass the retromolar area, pharynx, nasal cavity, paranasal sinuses, and larynx.

pmc-13040917.title: Enhancing prostate cancer diagnosis: a machine learning-based biomarker approach
pmc-13040917.creator: Patricia Porras-Quesada, Alberto Ramírez-Mena, Verónica Arenas-Rodríguez, Fernando Vázquez-Alonso, Jesús Alcalá-Fdez, Beatriz Álvarez-González, Luis Javier Martínez-González, María Jesús Álvarez-Cubero
pmc-13040917.description: BackgroundThe lack of reliable screening biomarkers for prostate cancer (PC) diagnosis makes tissue biopsy the gold-standard strategy. However, its frequent inconclusive results often lead to repeated procedures, increasing patient burden and healthcare costs. In this context, machine learning (ML) presents a novel approach for identifying gene signatures associated with tumor presence, offering a promising avenue for improved PC detection.

pmc-13213780.title: Multispectral imaging for zeaxanthin content in the exocarp of chili peppers
pmc-13213780.creator: Wei Liang, Wei Gao, Xingna Lv, Jinxiang Zhao, Xuechun Tian, Shuaitao Di, Qiang Li, Dongfang Zhang, ShuangXia Luo, XuePing Chen
pmc-13213780.description: This study developed a model to predict zeaxanthin content in peppers using multispectral imaging and chemical data. A one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D CNN) model was identified as the optimal single-modal model after comparing four machine learning algorithms. On the prediction dataset, the model achieved a determination coefficient (Rp2) of 0.7639.

pmc-13239887.title: A Qualitative Exploration of Unanticipated Effects Experienced By People With Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease Who Participated in Interventions Designed to Reduce Sedentary Behaviour
pmc-13239887.creator: Fiona Coll, Vinicius Cavalheri, Daniel F Gucciardi, Kylie Hill
pmc-13239887.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionThis study explored the lived experiences of people with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) who participated in interventions designed to reduce the accumulation of sedentary behaviour in prolonged uninterrupted bouts.MethodsTen participants with stable COPD participated in a multi‐component intervention that spanned over 9 months and was designed to address the intervention message ‘If you have been sitting or resting continuously for 30 min, stand up and move’.

pmc-13258954.title: Physiological and Transcriptomic Evaluation of Drought Tolerance in Alfalfa (Medicago sativa L.) and Identification of Resilient Germplasm
pmc-13258954.creator: Lixin Sun, Juan Zhou, Xiaoyan Zhao, Hongxia Ding, Rui Ma, Minshan Sun, Feng Wei
pmc-13258954.description: Drought stress is a major constraint on alfalfa (Medicago sativa L.) production. Screening for drought tolerance at the seedling stage can accelerate the identification of resilient germplasm. In this study, six alfalfa cultivars were selected and subjected to drought stress at the seedling stage.

pmc-13334869.title: Reconstruction of a Complex Pretibial Wound Using Dermal Regeneration Template and Split-Thickness Skin Graft
pmc-13334869.creator: Abhya Niegocki, Caleb W Brown, Nicole M Ceausu, Brian Q Le, Jeremy M Powers
pmc-13334869.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The reconstruction of the distal leg is challenging due to watershed vascularity and scarce soft-tissue bulk. While traditional reconstruction guidelines rely on vascularized flap coverage, such interventions are higher-risk options in certain patients with significant medical co-morbidities. This case report describes non-microsurgical reconstruction of a distal-third pre-tibial wound in a patient with a history of renal transplant, type 2 diabetes, coronary artery disease, and peripheral vascular disease.

pmc-13381645.title: Tissue-specific profiles of phenolic metabolites in rice deprived of OsCOP1, OsDET1, and OsCGT
pmc-13381645.creator: Hee-Jin Choi, Backki Kim, Muthu Thiruvengadam, Hee-Youn Chi, Bum-Su Jung, Jang-Won Kim, Seung-Bin Lee, Ja-Min Lee, Yunwoo Park, Dagyeom Jeon, Seung-Hyun Kim
pmc-13381645.description: Colored rice is recognized for its health-promoting properties, particularly its strong antioxidant activity. However, comparative analyses of phenolic metabolites across seed tissues and flavonoids beyond anthocyanidins remain limited. A comprehensive understanding of tissue-specific phenolic distribution and the regulatory mechanisms governing flavonoid diversification is essential for targeted metabolic engineering of nutritionally enhanced rice.
